speaker.role_note: The source page supplies the speaker label but does not establish a historical office; no role has been inferred from external knowledge.

speech.archive_title_note: The slug is a neutral archival subject label derived from the anthology's industrial theme, not a claim that the printed Assembly event carried that formal title.

source.relationship: For this speech, scan page = printed page + 1.

transcription.method: manual first-pass transcription from scan images, followed by full-speech completeness audit and strict direct page-by-page visual source-fidelity verification
transcription.completion_note: All 35 mapped scan pages 27-61 are represented. Markers are unique and monotonic. Scan p.61 ends with Kalaignar's final intervention and a decorative ornament; scan p.62 begins Speech 3 (03.05.1989).
transcription.verification_note: The complete Tamil transcript for scan pp.27-61 was checked directly page by page against the controlling scan. First-pass discrepancies found in that audit were corrected in transcript.md and documented in verification-log.md.

translation.placement: after the complete verified Tamil transcription
